tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a business website and return its Agent-Direct Score (0 to 100), grade, findings and fixes. Reuses a scan under 24 hours old; otherwise runs one, which takes 10 to 40 seconds.

tools.name: get_site_report
tools.description: Return the latest Agent-Direct report for a domain that has already been scanned, including findings, fixes and agent-discoverability checks.

tools.name: city_leaderboard
tools.description: Businesses in a city index ranked by Agent-Direct Score, with grade, menu format, direct channel and whether AI crawlers are blocked.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the city indexes that exist, with counts and status.
